Mazeflare
posts.content:
@D1D4K10 I understand your frustration completely, I share your sentiment for the most part, but as frustrated fan with the modern days UFC matchmaking, I'm definitelly fine with Taira getting the shot (not because I'm a big Taira fan, won't deny) but because Taira is developing his game on a incredibly high-rate to the point that even I counted him out on his last fight and the element of new generation versus new generation intrigues even more.

Gaethje vs Paddy? Atrocious.
Volk vs Lopes 2? Revolting.
Van vs Taira, in my humble opinion, right timing and amazing.

If you give the shot to Kape, there will be always uncertainty whether he will make it to the fight or not, plus, we would the boat on this incredible match-up with Van vs Taira. The UFC missed the boat with Jon Jones vs Anthony Johnson (R.I.P.), Jon Jones vs Francis Ngannou, Jon Jones vs Tom Aspinall, and low-key, Makhachev vs Topuria (at 170 it will not be competitive), this is an opportunity that shouldn't be missed.

posts.author: battousai
posts.content:
[Predictions]

@JeanSilvaEnjoyer
I do blame it on the missed weight, with the very obvious arguement being that if Perez completed his weight cut and was further depleted, he might not have had the power or timing to do what he ended up doing and that fight might have gone totally different. I dont think there was anything calculated about it. I think he just got lucky InnerG likes to fight a lot and didn't want that fight to get canceled.

Theres a reason why the UFC doesn't give bonuses to people who miss weight and its the same reason why saying Perez "ran through" Johnson is at bare minimum just lazy. Saying he "ran through him" implies he did something impressive, which he didn't. Theres multiple guys every single week who could walk in the cage and get knockout if you spot them a few pounds, but the rules exist for a reason.

Even if youre gonna take a fight with an asterisk into account, I still dont think its a great comparison. InnerG and Su outside of being longer strikers really aren't alike. Part of the reason Perez was able to KO InnerG is because he is a hilariously slow starter. Su is a more powerful striker and doesn't wait as long to get into a fight.

posts.author: FBoyMMA
posts.content:
[Predictions]

Yadong Vs Figuiredo
Song Yadong, DEC (49-46)
I don't really trust Song's cardio for 5 rounds, practically everything else is going for him.  Figgy's cardio isn't that good either but generally his power makes up for the low volume/pace. Song's wrestling will be just as useful if not a better tool in this fight than his boxing, in my opinion. Personally, I would prefer David Martinez over Figuiredo to be in this fight- especially since the former is actually coming off of a win and is much more deserving to fight up the ranks. Hope we can see an evolution in Song's style now, he's so young and ranked so high but I have the feeling his skills are somewhat stagnant training exclusively with Faber in Team Alpha Male.
